note: City of Medford campground in the 100-acre City Park on the Black River millpond. The west-side sites have 30/50-amp service, the east-side sites 120-volt. --Claude
summary: City page confirms everything: 9 sites (4x40 ft, 5x36 ft), $15/day incl. W/E, FCFS only, 14-day max, May 1-Sep 30; dump now by the ball diamonds on Centennial Pkwy (note said wastewater plant). Riverview kept. Pin at the pool ~200 m from the sites.
flags: WATERFRONT 'riverview' kept. On Esri imagery the camp road runs NW-SE along the Black River millpond at ~45.1427,-90.3529; the river channel there is only ~20 m wide (under 30 m, so never riverfront), and the east-side sites sit ~25-35 m from it across grass, a footpath and marsh fringe. No numbered site map exists, so no site can be named for an upgrade; a reviewer could consider creekside for the east-side sites only.
PIN 45.1410,-90.3520 sits at the city swimming pool; the nine sites are ~200 m NNW at about 45.1427,-90.3529 (under 250 m; optional move).
PHONE 715-748-4321 (city hall) not shown on the campground page; unchanged. WEBSITE https://medfordwi.gov/campground/ confirmed.
